# Computer Networks & DCCN Laboratory Solutions

> Complete educational reference suite containing Cisco Packet Tracer (.pkt) topologies, multi-threaded Python socket implementations, and Wireshark protocol analysis runbooks.

## Project Overview

- **Repository**: [computer-networks-lab](https://github.com/jjf2009/computer-networks-lab)
- **Primary Focus**: Undergraduate Computer Science networking curricula (DCCN / CN).
- **Core Stacks**: Cisco Packet Tracer v8.2+, Python 3.10+ standard library sockets, Wireshark 4.x.

## Core Modules & Resources

- [Cisco Packet Tracer Topologies](solution/packet-tracer/README.md): Verified network models including bus, star, ring, mesh, FLSM/VLSM subnet designs, dynamic routing topologies (RIPv2, OSPF, EIGRP), and multi-service server infrastructure.
- [Python Socket Implementations](solution/python/README.md): Native socket programming code in `servers.py` featuring multi-client TCP broadcast chat, RFC-compliant HTTP/1.1 static server, and an educational FTP daemon.
- [Wireshark Protocol Runbooks](solution/wireshark/wireshark_lab.md): Hands-on frame and packet dissection covering TCP handshakes, ARP resolutions, ICMP diagnostics, and cleartext vs cipher inspection.
- [Full LLM Knowledge Base](llms-full.txt): Comprehensive technical specifications, IP addressing schemes, routing comparison tables, and command references.
